result.reason: The clause includes the preferred CGL and E&O limits and certificates on request, but omits workers’ compensation as required by law and does not require cyber/privacy coverage if Garman processes Customer Data (USD 5M preferred; USD 2M fallback). It also imposes a one-year post-termination period on all coverage, including occurrence-based CGL, which is not required by the playbook and is broader than necessary. The existing headings provision is substantively preserved.
